# aaa.arif-fazil.com

## Purpose
DISPLAY_ONLY cockpit for the arifOS federation. Shows state, queues A2A. Never judges. Never executes.

## Canonical Pages
- Live cockpit: https://aaa.arif-fazil.com
- MCP door: https://mcp.arif-fazil.com/mcp
- Public HTML /webmcp console is not exposed.

## Connection
AAA shows. arifOS judges. A-FORGE executes. Arif controls.
